author: Bee
purpose: Actual play with floor-plan toolbar, levels and connections; invented pocket studio, not Lighthouse canon

candidate_served_after_play.scope: Served bytes fetched after completed candidate play; not a claim of frozen deployment or exact earlier in-memory module identity.

artifact_identity_limit: Candidate was in progress; after-play served hashes do not certify every earlier in-memory module or final deployment.
baseline_observations: Mouse and touch drawing created rooms.
Toolbar Door drag ending on a wall placed nothing on both surfaces.
Tap/click Door or Window then wall successfully placed openings on both surfaces.
Added upper level, set3.2 elevation, drew upper room, placed stairs/elevator and changed active level through UI.
Active level and destination labels helped explain linked floors.
Desktop and touch3D images showed active ground room and actual apertures.
candidate_observations: All five toolbar drags Door/Window/Passage/Stairs/Elevator placed on desktop and touch.
Actual touch Window ghost read release to place.
Explicitly cleared selection stayed empty after candidate gestures.
Touch two Undo taps removed two new connectors.
Desktop invalid Door wall-away drop preserved openings and gave wall-edge instruction.
Desktop two Undo then two Redo restored connector counts2→4.
practical_lessons: Ghost plus release/status feedback makes selected-tool-to-place connection clear.
Endpoint hint with active-level and marker destination labels resolves immediate route context.
Small-canvas connection labels and room name can collide; follow-up observation only.
Inspector/canvas round trips require vertical scrolling on touch.
Initial full-height front wall hides floor/character in3D; later directing should choose camera/cutaway deliberately.
scope_corrections: Selected2.7 text was not isolated to a particular baseline drag; no exact physical-phone selection reproduction claim.
Baseline Window drag target was room interior; exclude its non-placement from valid-wall defect claims.
Touch preview driver timeout followed by actual successful Stage pixels; not treated as app failure.
No final polygon/Text-node path approval; independent QA owns it.
